description.narrative: (Egypt): USAID is establishing 30 University Centers for Career Development at 23 universities to provide students and recent graduates with career mentoring services, marketable skills, English language training, private sector networking, internships, and, ultimately, jobs. Career guidance and training ensures that university graduates can more effectively transition to employment. These centers include specialized support for students with disabilities and will serve more than 70 percent of public university students in Egypt..The concept of career development and guidance counseling, relatively new to the Egyptian higher education system, is driven by deep engagement and connection to the private sector. Career centers have quickly created a network of local private industry representatives to inform target skills for entry-level professionals. The training and curriculum offered by each center is built around these priority skill areas. The Career Center project is implemented in partnership with the Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research..
